CA.rationale: Processing-origin ('command_estimate') is explicitly linked to the candidate content coordinates.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), its organization (coordinate listing) and a separate origin/status entry are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: A processing condition ('command_estimate') is explicitly associated with the candidate content's coordinates.

C.rationale: Multiple referents explicitly list identified content (color) and their coordinate attributes.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata entries are recorded separately from the content coordinate listings, distinguishing content identity from its provenance/status.

O.rationale: Content is presented as explicit coordinate patterns and a display-orientation mapping is stated.
